content: AI coding agent context-compression products like Headroom and Agno feature multi-compressor routing (AST-aware for code, SmartCrusher for JSON, pattern clustering for logs, article extraction for HTML), reversible compression via CCR (Cachable Context Retrieval) allowing on-demand retrieval of original content, multi-integration modes (CLI, library, OpenAI-compatible proxy, MCP server), and cross-agent memory to share context and corrections.
